rules.rationale: The exact native linear-unit definitions specify magnitude, length or linear density independently of an experiencer wanting or refusing it. All 56 source senses were inspected in the inventory; reviewed inch discovery and eight distinct held-out synsets agree with that interpretation, including mesh, head-based units, fistmele and combinatorial footer. Exact source identity and ancestry guards delimit the law; broader measurement classes and same-spelling senses are excluded. Admission is conditional and source-backed, not independent semantic gold. The failed BODY hypothesis is not admitted. Full-population migration and replay remain required.

head.n.11 explicitly defines a size through an anatomical head and received BODY=+1; footer.n.01 received null. Cubit and fistmele also have anatomical defining content despite model zeros, so these answers do not establish a stable universal BODY exclusion. No BODY audit answer is copied into the candidate. The proposal also lacks reviewed discovery. Retain all evidence for a later narrower source-backed investigation.
